sql: WITH oc AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.order_id,p.product_category_name category FROM olist_order_items i JOIN olist_products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL), dedup AS (SELECT category,payment_type,COUNT(*) n FROM oc JOIN olist_order_payments USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2), naive AS (SELECT p.product_category_name category,pay.payment_type,COUNT(*) n FROM olist_order_items i JOIN olist_products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id JOIN olist_order_payments pay ON pay.order_id=i.order_id GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT d.*,n.n item_join_count FROM dedup d JOIN naive n USING(category,payment_type) ORDER BY d.n DESC LIMIT 15
